answer.rationale: Do not counter the competitor with broad promotional pricing: the directly relevant 40% SMB discount increased signups and near-term qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, making it inconsistent with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Roll out the already-confirmed shortened onboarding flow for self-serve/SMB accounts; it improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention. This will not fully eliminate price-driven churn, so monitor churn, renewal, and qualified-revenue cohorts closely rather than assuming onboarding offsets the competitive price gap.
